usql, the universal command-line interface for SQL databases

Usage:
  usql [OPTION]... [DSN]

General options:
  -c, --command=COMMAND    run only single command (SQL or internal) and exit
  -d, --dbname=DSN         database url or connection name to connect to
  -f, --file=FILE          execute commands from file, then exit
  -l, --list               list available databases, then exit
  -v, --set=, --variable=NAME=VALUE
                           set script variable NAME to VALUE (see \set command)
  -O, --option=NAME=VALUE  set configuration option NAME (SECTION.NAME) to VALUE (see \config command)
  -U, --uset=NAME=VALUE    set setting NAME of usql to VALUE (see \uset command)
  -N, --cset=NAME=DSN      set named connection NAME to DSN (see \cset command)
  -D, --dump               write the database as a usql script to standard output or to the file of -o, then exit
      --config=FILE        config file
  -V, --version            output version information, then exit
  -X, --no-init            do not execute initialization scripts
  -1, --single-transaction
                           execute as a single transaction (if non-interactive)
  -?, --help               show this help, then exit

Input and output options:
  -E, --echo-hidden        display queries that internal commands generate
  -o, --output=FILE        send query results to file
  -q, --quiet              run quietly (no messages, only query output)

Output format options:
  -A, --no-align           unaligned table output mode
  -C, --csv                CSV output mode
  -F, --field-separator=STRING
                           field separator for unaligned and CSV output (default "|" and ",")
  -G, --vertical           vertical output mode
  -H, --html               HTML table output mode
  -J, --json               JSON output mode
  -M, --markdown           markdown output mode
  -P, --pset=VAR=ARG       set printing option VAR to ARG (see \pset command)
  -R, --record-separator=STRING
                           record separator for unaligned and CSV output (default \n)
  -t, --tuples-only        print rows only
  -T, --table-attr=TEXT    set HTML table tag attributes (e.g., width, border)
  -x, --expanded           turn on expanded table output
  -z, --field-separator-zero
                           set field separator for unaligned and CSV output to zero byte
  -0, --record-separator-zero
                           set record separator for unaligned and CSV output to zero byte

Connection options:
  -w, --no-password        never prompt for password
  -W, --password           force password prompt (should happen automatically)

For more information, type "\?" (for internal commands) or "\help" (for SQL
commands) from within usql, or see https://github.com/xo/usql.
